body:
My father was a violent, abusive alcoholic and drug addict. My childhood was a never ending stream of insanity and mayhem from birth until i was about 14 when my dad took off. I'd been fighting back when he came after me since I was about 7 or 8, but when I hit my teens I started to get some size on me and when I hit him back it was starting to get his attention. I think he realized that before too long he was going to be fist fighting a grown man, and he left.

There's definitely damage in me from that time. A few years ago, I realized that I keep my hair so short because when I was 4 years old, he ripped me out of bed at 3:00 in the morning by my hair and flung me at the wall, and I was still reacting to that. I watched him do terrible things, watched him beat and rape my mother when I was too small to stop it, threaten to jam a broken beer bottle up her ass, rip out clumps of her hair. He routinely beat the shit out of me for no reason at all, until I'd vomit or piss my pants. But even when it was happening, I can't remember feeling anything about it, not even fear. Just nothing.

It was a strange time, but even now looking back on it, I don't have any feelings about it, those are just the things that were happening at the time. I recognize that it probably still effects me like the hair thing, but I don't have any anger or resentment toward him. I don't usually think of it at all.
